title: Handcycle Maximal Perceptually-Regulated Exercise Test Using a Cyclus 2 Ergometer
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.idcca2w

steps.title: Assemble handcycle on ergometer
steps.instruction: Attach the handcycle to the Cyclus 2 ergometer, remove its front wheel, loop the chain over the Cyclus 2 sprocket, and attach the electronic shifter to one handle.

substeps.instruction: Attach handcycle to Cyclus 2 frame
Remove front wheel of handcycle
Loop chain over Cyclus 2 sprocket
Attach electronic shifter to a handle

steps.title: Configure ergometer settings
steps.instruction: Open the “system” tab of the main menu on the display screen, enter the correct handcycle and participant settings, and set the ergometer to “power‑based manual control.”

steps.title: Seat participant and record position
steps.instruction: Help the participant get into the handcycle, adjust the configuration for comfort (allow slight elbow flexion at the furthest pedal point), and record the handcycle position for future repeat testing.

steps.title: Perform self‑selected warm‑up
steps.instruction: Allow the participant to perform a self‑selected warm‑up of any duration and intensity; monitor cadence and note the participant’s preferred cadence.

steps.title: Prepare display and RPE scale
steps.instruction: Cover the display so that only the “time” and “cadence” readouts are visible to the participant, and ensure the RPE 6‑20 scale remains visible throughout the test.

steps.title: Explain RPE protocol to participant
steps.instruction: Read the following instructions: describe the 6‑20 RPE scale, explain that five intensities (11, 13, 15, 17, 20) will be performed in order, each for 2 minutes, and that the participant may adjust resistance to maintain the target RPE; tell them you will announce time remaining every 30 seconds and that they should focus on overall effort, not just arms or breathing.

steps.title: Stage 1: RPE 11
steps.instruction: Begin Stage 1 (target RPE 11, 2 minutes). Instruct the participant to adjust power output as needed to keep an RPE of 11. Every 15 seconds remind them of time left and the target RPE. With 15 seconds remaining, ask for verbal reports of peripheral, central, and overall RPE. Record the RPE at the end of the stage.

substeps.instruction: Start 2‑minute stage, target RPE 11
Every 15 s: remind time left and target RPE
At 15 s remaining: collect peripheral, central, overall RPE
At stage end: record final RPE

steps.title: Stage 2: RPE 13
steps.instruction: Begin Stage 2 (target RPE 13, 2 minutes) following the same procedure as Stage 1: allow power adjustments, give 15‑second reminders, collect differentiated RPE at 15 seconds left, and record end‑stage RPE.

substeps.instruction: Start 2‑minute stage, target RPE 13
Every 15 s: remind time left and target RPE
At 15 s remaining: collect peripheral, central, overall RPE
At stage end: record final RPE

steps.title: Stage 3: RPE 15
steps.instruction: Begin Stage 3 (target RPE 15, 2 minutes) using the same reminder and data‑collection pattern as previous stages.

substeps.instruction: Start 2‑minute stage, target RPE 15
Every 15 s: remind time left and target RPE
At 15 s remaining: collect peripheral, central, overall RPE
At stage end: record final RPE

steps.title: Stage 4: RPE 17
steps.instruction: Begin Stage 4 (target RPE 17, 2 minutes) using the same reminder and data‑collection pattern as previous stages.

substeps.instruction: Start 2‑minute stage, target RPE 17
Every 15 s: remind time left and target RPE
At 15 s remaining: collect peripheral, central, overall RPE
At stage end: record final RPE

steps.title: Stage 5: RPE 20 to exhaustion
steps.instruction: Begin Stage 5 (target RPE 20, 2 minutes). Instruct the participant to increase power output so that volitional exhaustion occurs exactly at the end of the stage; emphasize not to perform an all‑out sprint followed by a decline. Continue 15‑second reminders and record the final RPE.

substeps.instruction: Start 2‑minute stage, target RPE 20
Explain goal: reach exhaustion at stage end, no sprint‑then‑decline
Every 15 s: remind time left and target RPE
At stage end: record final RPE

steps.title: Terminate test and save data
steps.instruction: After the final stage (total 10 minutes), press “escape” on the display to remove all resistance, save the test data for later analysis, and allow the participant to cool down and exit the handcycle when ready.
